C. Practical Implementation of BVR-L-SGD
In this section, we give practical implementation details of BVR-L-SGD (Algorithm 4). The blue texts indicates the changes
from the original algorithm (Algorithm 2) for more specific, and computational and communication efficient procedures.
In line 1, we set T = d1 + eb/(Kb)e, which has been theoretically determined. In line 16, we at first pick a worker p̂
uniformly random and send aggregated variance reduced gradient vet to it. Then, worker p̂ runs Local-Routine using vet (line
18). Central server receive its output and broadcast it to all the worker (line 19). Note that Algorithm 4 only requires single
aggregation and single broadcast for each t ∈ [T ].

D. Supplementary of Numerical Experiments
Parameter Tuning
For all the implemented algorithms, the only tuning parameter was learning rate η. We ran each algorithm with η ∈
{0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0} and chose the one that maximized the minimum train accuracy at the last 100 global
iterates to take into account not only convergence speed but also stability of convergence.
